headline: Fender’s CEO seems to think your bandmates are just analog AI
summary: Fender CEO Edward "Bud" Cole sparked controversy with comments on AI in music. He reportedly compared bandmates to "analog AI" during a Telecaster anniversary interview. The remarks are fueling existing PR issues for the company.

headline: Xbox prices are increasing by up to €200 or £170
summary: Microsoft announced significant Xbox price hikes for EU and UK markets. Prices will increase by up to €200 or £170 depending on the model. The 1TB Xbox Series X with a disc drive is particularly affected.

headline: Skylight's smart calendars are up to $90 off during its back-to-school sale
summary: Skylight smart calendars are on sale, offering up to $90 off. The back-to-school promotion runs from August 2nd to August 9th. These calendars help families manage hectic schedules and responsibilities.

headline: HP’s HyperX Omen 15 isn’t quite the budget-friendly gaming laptop its predecessor was
summary: The new HP HyperX Omen 15 replaces the budget-friendly Victus 15. Unlike its predecessor, the Omen 15 is not positioned as a budget gaming laptop. It offers upgrades like the RTX 5050, but at a higher price point.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Comes Close to Passing Avengers: Endgame With Second Biggest Box Office Debut of All Time at $927 Million Globally
summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" debuted with an estimated $927 million globally. This makes it the second-biggest box office opening of all time. The film nearly surpassed "Avengers: Endgame"'s record.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection, Saros, Death Stranding 2, and More
summary: Explore today's top gaming deals and discounts. Featured titles include Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection. Discover savings on Saros, Death Stranding 2, and more.

headline: Hideo Kojima Reviews Spider-Man: Brand New Day: 'It Felt Fresh, and I Really Enjoyed It'
summary: Hideo Kojima reviewed "Spider-Man: Brand New Day." The renowned game creator "really enjoyed" the film. He praised its "fresh" take on a "lonely Peter Parker."

headline: What the Heck Is Marvel Doing With the Hulk Anyway!?
summary: Fans are questioning Marvel's current direction for the Hulk. The query arises post-"Spider-Man: Brand New Day" events. The article explores the character's status and potential future.

headline: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece, as British pilot survives
summary: Two firefighting helicopters collided in Greece, resulting in two fatalities. A Danish and a Greek national died in the incident. A British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.

headline: Burnham pledges to be 'relentless' in curbing small boat crossings
summary: Burnham pledges "relentless" action against small boat crossings. The prime minister stresses increased enforcement measures. He also advocates for more safe routes into the UK.

headline: Man admits transporting Scottish woman's body in suitcase, Greek police say
summary: A man admitted transporting a Scottish woman's body in a suitcase in Greece. He has been arrested on suspicion of manslaughter. Robbery and weapons offences are also part of the charges.

headline: Prolonged drought could cause shortage of some foods, farmers' union head says
summary: A prolonged drought threatens potential food shortages in the UK. NFU president Tom Bradshaw urges government action to prevent impact. Concerns are raised about extreme weather affecting food supply.
